verdict.rationale: OpenCode can run as a cloud agent through its GitHub integration: mentioning /opencode or /oc makes it execute tasks in a GitHub Actions runner, implement a feature on a new branch, and submit a PR for review. It can also run headless via `opencode serve` with remote attach, and `--auto` enables unattended approval. Missing for 10: evidence that the agent runs tests as part of the cloud workflow, any demo artifact (screenshots, video, preview deploy) for review, a first-party hosted cloud agent environment, and independent hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end flow.
